MRK.rationale: MRK presents a moderately attractive fundamental case anchored by a genuine earnings inflection — Q3 2025 EPS of $2.32 (+87.1% YoY), net margin expanding from 19.3% to 29.6%, and ROE reaching 36.7%. Cash generation in the quarter was solid (OCF/NI = 1.35x). The franchise quality is high: Keytruda at $31.7B in 2025 is the world's best-selling drug, WINREVAIR is growing 141%, and the R&D machine has ~80 Phase 3 trials underway. However, the investment case is inseparable from the Keytruda patent cliff in late 2028 (~49% of revenue at risk), and recent pipeline setbacks (LITESPARK-012 failure 2026-04-21, gefapixant CRL) narrow the diversification path. Valuation at 15x PE is no longer cheap — the stock has already re-rated ~36% from its trough — though EV/EBITDA ~8.67x versus historical 12-16x suggests the patent cliff is partially priced. The Q1 2026 earnings report on April 30 is a near-term catalyst, but consensus expects a loss quarter (EPS -$1.31), which could create volatility. Oil at $99/bbl is an emerging input-cost headwind. Net: strong recent earnings trajectory and reasonable valuation offset by concentration risk, partially-consumed re-rating, and mixed near-term visibility. Mild positive bias.
